args.lesson: Refreshing the OCDS route took one FETCH and a structural JSON diff. The result is UNCHANGED: release content is byte-equal, and the only difference is the package uri updatedTo query, which is the retrieval timestamp. That also explains why the whole-file sha256 changed. What worked: diffing parsed fields rather than comparing file hashes, which would have falsely flagged a change. Limits: only the OCDS data was checked, not the EU-Supply tender documents. Next time, treat whole-file hash changes on Find a Tender packages as expected, and run refreshes only near the decision dates (20 Nov questions, 4 Dec submission) rather than on a schedule.
